cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 is the stronger route, buffered by milder secondary anionics (Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate #5, Sodium Lauroyl Glutamate #7), nonionic Laureth-2 #3 and Panthenol #4 / PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate #10. Moderate anchor: one stronger route substantially buffered by secondary surfactants. No amphoteric, so C1 does not apply directly; no clarifying/reset intent.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Three anionic routes and no betaine buffer can be read as 'multiple reinforcing cleansing routes' (strong).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; only a light cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-7 #13), Panthenol #4 and late Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein #17. No silicone, fatty alcohol or lipid. Claims corroborate ('bewusst leicht dosierte Pflegestoffe').

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one light polymer (#13) and a late protein (#17); nothing persistent.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: One light polymer and late protein, anchor says this can remain low.

focusPrimary.rationale: General: the dominant positioning is menopausal hair loss / root activation (Phyto-Coffein), which is medically adjacent and outside scope, so it cannot carry a focus. The remaining claims ('für feines, brüchiges Haar', volume retained because care is lightly dosed) are thickness/outcome language; repair for brittle hair has a nonspecific verdict (one protein token #17 + Panthenol #4 is not a coherent damage-care cluster); volume is a by-product claim, not the product's dominant job.

careDirection.limitation: Single protein token; light conditioning only.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Light, volume-compatible formula with an explicit 'Frisur behält ihr Volumen' claim.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: light SLES/sulfosuccinate/glutamate chassis, low conditioning -> nonspecific. Unblind: dominant hair-loss claims are out of scope; brittle-hair claim fails repair verdict; volume is secondary outcome wording -> general.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: no distinct secondary positioning with an independent route; the volume wording is an outcome of the light conditioning load, i.e. a restatement of conditioning/weight (§8 condition 3).

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: explicit 'Täglich anwenden' / 'Bei jeder Haarwäsche benutzen' and cleansingStrength moderate (not strong). Caffeine is not a recognized active under this cosmetic standard (hair loss out of scope), so not treatment.
usageRole.counterSignal: If cleansing were strong, the role would fall to regular.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: no sensitive/itchy/dry-scalp positioning ('Widerstandskraft von Kopfhaut' is hair-loss/root positioning); complete ordinary formula.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Niacinamide #16 (listed comfort route) is present but without positioning.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Zinc PCA #15 is not a recognized active under §11.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T2: 'für feines Haar' claim corroborates only. T4: no neighbors on W or C -> no flags.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-HAIRLOSS: the only scalp-adjacent positioning is hair loss / root activation, which was not evaluated and creates no target; no E2 scalp claim -> S-ORDINARY.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong would also give regular (no clarifying focus/usage) -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: No D1 term; D2 not met.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Focus when the dominant claim is out-of-scope hair loss: §7 has no explicit row; S-HAIRLOSS covers targets only. Resolved to general (7.2 'unsupported/generic claims').

usageRole 'treatment' is defined as 'problem-led recognized active route'; standard does not state whether hair-loss actives (caffeine) can count. Treated as not recognized because hair-loss efficacy is out of scope.
C1 assumes an amphoteric buffer; a SLES + sulfosuccinate + glutamate system without betaine is not covered; resolved by the moderate anchor ('substantially buffered by secondary surfactants').
